policy: Stable catalog IDs are authoritative. Matching names produce review candidates, never automatic aliases. Revisions, regions, capacity variants and partner cards remain distinct. Unknown is not equal.

aliases.finding: Both local records name the MSI MAG B850 TOMAHAWK MAX WIFI. The generic component record explicitly lacks a regional SKU/revision and came from a family listing. Official exact-model pages confirm the named model, but do not prove that every unspecified regional/revision identity in the legacy family record is interchangeable.
aliases.action: Retain both IDs and self canonicals. Link the better documented named model as a related record. Review exact model code/revision from the legacy data source before approving a permanent alias.

aliases.finding: The names agree with official model documentation. The legacy manufacturer-family record has no exact regional SKU or revision. Name agreement alone is insufficient for an automatic saved-build or product-URL migration.
aliases.action: Retain IDs until the exact identity is reviewed. No destructive consolidation or HTTP redirect is enabled.

known_distinct.reason: Base GPU specification versus MSI partner card G5070-12V3C; different physical dimensions and clocks.
8 GB and 6 GB variants have different memory interfaces, core counts and power specifications.
Base GPU versus exact partner cards; 8 GB versus 12 GB and OC versus non-OC remain separate.
Original solid-front 4000D, 4000D Airflow and FRAME 4000D are different case designs.
The documented record cites rev 1.2; the other has no revision. Do not equate unknown revision with rev 1.2.
FOCUS GX naming spans revisions; one record lacks a revision and one lists 2024. Wattage and a shared name do not establish the same connectors or generation.
Regional manufacturer pages and storage/SIM code are unresolved. Do not merge a family record into a specific phone cohort on name alone.
